notes:
Account intro: product org (2 PMs) + platform (4 infra) + support ops. Trial started 2026-02-01 using Hosted API (free credits). Primary goal: in-app assistant for product discovery + reduce support triage time.

Trial highlights (hosted API):
- 2-week proof-of-concept: integrated chat endpoint into staging mobile/web clients.
- Collected real traffic sample: 17K requests, ~8.9M tokens total.
- Token mix: ~65% short prompts (<120 prompt tokens) with ~40-60 token completions. 35% long prompts (contextual product history) avg 600 prompt tokens, completions avg 180 tokens.
- Avg prompt tokens per req: 280 (weighted); avg completion tokens: 85.
- Observed p95 latency (hosted): 430ms for short requests, 1.4s for long-context requests (they expect to lower with dedicated).
- Concurrency observed during peak trial: sustained ~40 concurrent requests, burst up to 95 QPS for short bursts.
- Cost sensitivity: clearly cost-aware; asked for unit economics (cost per 1K tokens) and projected monthly spend at scale.

Customer quotes: "We need predictable costs — can't have wild monthly spikes." "If Dedicated lets us hit 100 QPS with <200ms median, we'll switch."

Security/compliance: Submitted initial security questionnaire. Need SSO + audit logs + KMS integration. Ask: data residency for EU customers (some EU enterprise customers).

POC/Demo notes: SE ran a canary with caching prefixes for product descriptions (reduced tokens by ~12%). Tested fallback routing to smaller model for low-priority recs — acceptable quality tradeoff.

Internal commercial: AE (Jordan) and finance discussing 12-month committed Dedicated pricing vs. pay-as-you-go for Hosted. Customer prefers committed to get cost certainty but requests a 3 month ramp credit.

Open items: pricing for mixed model routing (gpt-variant for chat + smaller embedding model), SLA for latency p50/p95, exact Dedicated sizing recommendation, VPC peering timeline, legal DPA clause for EU residency.

technical_summary:
Observed trial metrics used to generate Dedicated sizing. Traffic mix: 65% short-chat, 35% long-context product history requests. Peak observed QPS (hosted trial) 95 burst; sustained 40 QPS. Recommended Dedicated starting point: 4 x A100-equivalent GPUs (or 8 x T4-equivalent for mixed batching) to support 100 sustained QPS with expected batching and KV caching; expected concurrency headroom 120 concurrent sessions with autoscale to 8 GPUs for peak. Estimated monthly tokens at scale: 60M-120M tokens/month depending on adoption (approx 25-50M completion tokens). Optimizations: prefix caching for product descriptions, dedupe embeddings cache, route low-priority reranking to quantized smaller model.

Sizing assumptions: avg resp token 85, avg prompt token 280, target p95 latency <700ms for short requests, p95 <1.2s for long requests with Dedicated + batching. Cost model provided in pricing deck (drive link).
dedicated_capacity_request: Requested baseline capacity: support 100 QPS sustained, burst to 200 QPS for 10m windows
Estimated GPUs: 4 x A100-equivalent (NVIDIA A10/A100 or similar) with autoscale to 8 for seasonal peaks
Networking: VPC peering + 10 Gbps egress budgeting; need static IPs for allowlisting
forecast_and_financials: Adoption scenarios: conservative (5% of monthly MAUs -> 60M tokens/mo) vs aggressive (12% -> 150M tokens/mo)
Estimated monthly hosted cost at current usage profile: $6k-$12k (hosted) — dedicated committed pricing expected to reduce unit cost by ~35-45%
Estimated ARR (if committed) based on mid adoption: $150k-$240k ARR depending on discounting and commitment term
